data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'gylle', meaning 'small wave'. In the Bible, Gill is mentioned in the Old Testament as a servant of King Saul, and in the New Testament as the name of a centurion who had faith and healed his paralyzed friend. The name Gill carries the meaning “Small wave” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Gill usually hope their child will grow to embody small wave and live with faith, good character and purpose.
